# first_window_probes_frames30.txt - DEMO-1 D6-red (D-W8-72, D-W8-80) and EXAMPLE-PROBE-Y (D-W8-227): the 9 edge
# probes of the 30th drawn frame of `first_window --frames 30`, Linux only (tests/container/run_example_capture.sh).
# With --frames, the green square of drawn frame d sits at x = 20 + 2 * (d - 1), y = 400, 32 by 32, so frame 30
# covers x 78 to 109 and y 400 to 431. Tolerance 0: the column edges on row 415 accept ONLY d = 30 (d = 29 turns
# (77, 415) green; d = 31 turns (78, 415) background), and the row edges on column 93 accept ONLY y = 400 (a square
# one pixel higher turns (93, 399) green and (93, 431) background; one pixel lower is the mirror). Format:
# tests/tools/image_probe.py. Fixed BEFORE the data existed (GODS_LAWS.md L-43).
#
# just left of the square: background
77 415 7C7C7CFF 0
# the first and the last column of the square: green
78 415 00FF00FF 0
109 415 00FF00FF 0
# just right of the square: background
110 415 7C7C7CFF 0
# where the square was in drawn frame 1 (x = 20 to 51): background
36 415 7C7C7CFF 0
# the first and the last row of the square, on its middle column: green
93 400 00FF00FF 0
93 431 00FF00FF 0
# just above and just below the square: background
93 399 7C7C7CFF 0
93 432 7C7C7CFF 0
